name: gameasset-forge
description: Local-first deterministic 2D game asset preparation pipeline.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gameasset-forge/core && npm run build --workspace @gameasset-forge/cli && npm run build --workspace @gameasset-forge/gui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @gameasset-forge/core --silent && npm run typecheck --workspace @gameasset-forge/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @gameasset-forge/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @gameasset-forge/gui
